name: dsh-knowledge-graph
description: DSH Cordis plugin: turn arbitrary source text into an AI-generated knowledge graph (facts / inferences / concepts / definitions / examples / counter-examples / rules) with two-way linking between the graph and the original text, plus evidence-grounded verification, questioning, one-click fixes and an audit log.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-lib.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs && node scripts/build-viewer.mjs
